advice: Abstain. The supplied NN kernel already uses contiguous paired FP32 LD1W loads for both operands and contiguous predicated FP32 output stores. The transpose helper also uses contiguous row loads and column stores. No distinct legal vector-access change is supported by the evidence.
risks: A new access layout would overlap separately ranked packing or traversal work. Wider or aligned accesses would assume alignment not established here and could break bounds for general sizes or tails. No performance effect is established.
